title: The game's identity: resourceful joy under pressure
context: The concept audit (2026-09-14-concept-audit-first-pass) asked which single emotion the game is for, offering resourceful joy under pressure as a candidate that reconciles Isao's protopian optimism with the military register of the gunship and sentries. Owner: 'lots to do, like Isao, let's keep positive under pressure! so much to do! I like that as the identity; resourceful joy under pressure.'
outcome: Accepted as the identity every component answers to (Rosewater 6): the pressure is the swarm, the clock and the military hardware; the joy is Isao, the builder who rebuilds, and the colony growing out of the wreck it arrived in. A component that serves neither the pressure nor the joy is a candidate to cut. Recorded at the top of docs/FUNMAP.md.
alternatives: Leaving the emotion unnamed: the audit found the two registers pulling against each other without a chosen contrast.
